title: How do you think?
html:
Have you ever thought about how you think? As I was thinking (sorry) this morning about what to write (and it's a holiday in Auckland so it took awhile to get into gear), I thought about how I am in meetings and how I can go off on tangents.

These tangents are usually used to illustrate a point but can be quite annoying for some colleagues and can extend a meeting somewhat. Also I sometimes get technical and I can now see when someone’s eyes are glazing over. It has taken me a long time to pick up when I am doing this.

It seems I come up with my best ideas whilst talking through things. On my feet, with a whiteboard, is even better as I can show someone my idea with pictures. In looking through my meeting notes, I can see I draw a lot. A simple box with an arrow to another box can demonstrate something far quicker than ten minutes of talking, in some cases.

So how do YOU think? Don't answer this question today. Keep the question on a piece of paper somewhere on your desk and answer it at the end of the week. Then send your answers to me. No prizes, but I will put all the feedback on my blog, so they can be discussed.

Knowing how you think is a distinct advantage as you can then place yourself in situations that maximise your contribution and ideas.
